```{r Step 2: Census QWI Pull, include=TRUE}
my_key <- "1a447b57b802a82f3c8a2a62cd499bb781c2fbc6"

get_qwi_county <- function(state_fips,
                           time_period,
                           vars = c("TurnOvrS",
                                    "HirA",
                                    "Sep",
                                    "FrmJbC",
                                    "FrmJbLs",
                                    "EarnS",
                                    "Emp")) {

  req <- request("https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/qwi/sa") |>
    req_url_query(
      get = paste(vars, collapse = ","),
      `for` = "county:*",
      `in` = paste0("state:", state_fips),
      time = time_period,
      sex = "0",
      agegrp = "A00",
      industry = "00",
      key = my_key
    )

  resp <- tryCatch(req |> req_perform(), error = function(e) return(NULL))
  if (is.null(resp)) return(tibble())

  txt <- tryCatch(resp_body_string(resp), error = function(e) return(""))

  if (nchar(txt) == 0 || grepl("<html", txt)) return(tibble())

  parsed <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(txt), error = function(e) return(NULL))
  if (is.null(parsed) || length(parsed) < 2) return(tibble())

  df <- as_tibble(parsed[-1, , drop = FALSE])
  names(df) <- parsed[1, ]

  df %>%
    mutate(
      state = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(state)),
      county = sprintf("%03d", as.integer(county)),
      county_fips = paste0(state, county)
    )
}

years <- 2006:2025
quarters <- sprintf("%d-Q%d", rep(years, each = 4), 1:4)

time_grid <- quarters

states <- sprintf("%02d", 1:56)

pull_all_qwi <- function(variable = "TurnOvrS") {

  grid <- expand.grid(
    state = sprintf("%02d", 1:56),
    time = sprintf("%d-Q%d", rep(2006:2025, each = 4), 1:4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  results <- vector("list", nrow(grid))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {

    state <- grid$state[i]
    time  <- grid$time[i]

    message("Pulling: state ", state, " | ", time)

    results[[i]] <- tryCatch(
      get_qwi_county(state, time, vars = variable),
      error = function(e) tibble()
    )

  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

test <- pull_all_qwi("TurnOvrS")
test2 <- pull_all_qwi("EmpS")
test3 <- pull_all_qwi("EarnS")
test4 <- pull_all_qwi("Sep")
test5 <- pull_all_qwi("FrmJbC")
test6 <- pull_all_qwi("HirA")
test7 <- pull_all_qwi("FrmJbLs")
```
